technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with stochastic/RSI bounces present, but price remains below all key moving averages with bearish MACD and weak ADX—confluence is insufficient for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: STZ shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 17 days with no fundamental tailwinds.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and non-directional; market fear (37/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and bearish AAII sentiment (44.6%) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (234.4) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 17 days create binary event risk; macro environment is severely unfavourable for STZ.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stochastic) with Supertrend bullish signal and price near support (214.61) offer contrarian bounce opportunity in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, bearish MACD, weak ADX trend confirmation, high earnings risk in 17 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and zero fundamental/insider conviction create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stochastic) present technical bounce opportunity; however, price remains structurally below all major moving averages with bearish MACD and zero fundamental conviction, making risk-reward unacceptable.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 17 days combined with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels (234.4) create uncontrollable downside risk that overshadows any technical bounce potential.
